children.name: The field guide / read in two minutes

children.name: The playground is the lesson. Every sample uses real project data, editable layers and the same runtime as your exported HTML.

props.text: The playground is the lesson. Every sample uses real project data, editable layers and the same runtime as your exported HTML.

children.name: In the Layers panel, find “Editor · stagger”, “Editor · hover scale” or “Editor · click bounce”. Their Animation panel contains the working preset, trigger and timing.

props.text: In the Layers panel, find “Editor · stagger”, “Editor · hover scale” or “Editor · click bounce”. Their Animation panel contains the working preset, trigger and timing.

children.name: Editing keeps everything still. Use Preview or preview the selected component, try an interaction, then stop playback to return to the saved design. Replay page replays the entrance.

props.text: Editing keeps everything still. Use Preview or preview the selected component, try an interaction, then stop playback to return to the saved design. Replay page replays the entrance.

children.name: Select “Script · pointer tilt” or “Script · spring orbit”, then open Script → Edit script and source. The parameter fields below are connected to ctx.props.

props.text: Select “Script · pointer tilt” or “Script · spring orbit”, then open Script → Edit script and source. The parameter fields below are connected to ctx.props.

children.name: Edit a number, rename a label, recolor a shape or duplicate a demo. Script selectors stay inside ctx.el, so copied examples keep working independently.

props.text: A click becomes a state change.

children.name: Excerpt from the orbit button’s editable source. start() runs a short ctx.onFrame spring. The full mount(ctx) function includes parameters, reduced-motion handling and a cleanup function.

props.text: Excerpt from the orbit button’s editable source. start() runs a short ctx.onFrame spring. The full mount(ctx) function includes parameters, reduced-motion handling and a cleanup function.

children.name: Native buttons work with pointer, touch, Enter and Space. With reduced motion enabled, presets stay still, pointer tilt is skipped and the orbit changes state immediately. Changes to this preference are handled while Preview is open.

props.text: Native buttons work with pointer, touch, Enter and Space. With reduced motion enabled, presets stay still, pointer tilt is skipped and the orbit changes state immediately. Changes to this preference are handled while Preview is open.

children.name: These scripts start frames only after input and unregister them once settled. Their returned cleanup functions stop work and restore presentation. ctx owns the event listeners, so stopping Preview or changing pages releases them too.

children.name: Try a 240ms entrance delay, a gentler 6° tilt or a softer orbit spring. Use ordinary Undo to return to the original.
